# Xiaoling (Mia) Zhou — Portfolio

> Senior Product Designer making complex systems feel clear, useful, and human.

Canonical human-readable page: /

Email: xznew2016@gmail.com

## Profile

Xiaoling (Mia) Zhou is a Senior Product Designer with 8+ years of experience across financial services, healthcare, connected devices, employee tools, and AI-enabled products. She leads 0-to-1 work from discovery through launch and combines human-centered design, research, analytics, and prototyping.

## Projects

### Personal Loan Calculator — OneMain Financial
Designed an educational, responsive calculator that helps people understand how loan amount, APR, and term shape estimated monthly payments.
Public product: https://www.onemainfinancial.com/personal-loans/resources/financial-calculators/personal-loan
Portfolio case study: /work/personal-loan-calculator/

### Guided Collections — OneMain Financial
Designed an internal collections tool that helps team members find the right account, understand the situation, and take the next action with confidence. The work included research, workshop facilitation, workflow mapping, search design, trusted automation, and a focused invitation experience.
Portfolio case study: /work/guided-collections/

### OneAdvisor — OneMain Financial
Designed an AI-enabled tool for team members, translating complex service workflows into a more guided digital experience.

### Ready by 4:30 — Personal project
Xiaoling’s first web coded product is a task timer made for her six year old son. It makes his afternoon routine visible through a deadline, four clear tasks, changing time feedback, and a Pokémon reward when everything is complete. Its simplicity is central to the story: AI made a deeply specific tool achievable for one real person and changed how Xiaoling thinks about the value of AI.
Portfolio case study: /work/ready-by-430/

### Earlier connected-product work
- WYZE Camera: design improvements for loading, zooming, and the interactive sales experience. Case study: /work/wyze-camera/
- iHealth Thermometer: product design across more than 15 hardware and software iterations. Project archive: /work/thermometer/
- iHealth Blood Pressure Monitor: research led improvements for a connected health experience. Case study: /work/blood-pressure-monitor/
- Sitting Feeling: human factors research and predictive modeling for sitting comfort. Case study: /work/sitting-feeling/
- Other Works: publishing, product design, illustration, and coding beyond full time work. Archive: /work/other-works/

## Journey

- 2013: iF Design Award — Concept Design Award / Top 135; International Design Award / Top 40.
- 2014: B.S.E. Industrial Design, Nanjing Forestry University; UX Design Intern at Yodo1 Games.
- 2014–2016: Human Factors Researcher, Mississippi State University; M.S. Sustainable Bioproducts with a Statistics minor.
- 2017–2018: UX Designer, iHealth Labs.
- 2018–2021: Independent / Freelance UX Designer.
- 2021: M.S. Analytics, Georgia Institute of Technology.
- 2021–present: UX Designer, OneMain Financial.

## Capabilities

Product strategy, 0-to-1 product development, interaction design, visual design, responsive design, prototyping, design systems, accessibility, user research, usability testing, workflow mapping, data analysis, experimentation, research synthesis, AI-enabled product design, financial-service workflows, employee tools, and rapid concept validation.
